description: Use this only when a signed in customer clearly asks to return items from a teas.co.uk order. Confirm the order, items and reason with them first, and check that order's can_return (from my_orders or track_order). order_number must be an order on the linked account. Each item is a product id from that order, and its quantity is capped at the quantity bought; products not in the order are ignored, and if none match it returns an error. details is what happened, in the customer's words. The request goes to the teas.co.uk team, who review it and email the next steps; it refunds or changes nothing by itself. Sending the same request again is flagged with duplicate true instead of being filed twice. For the returns policy use delivery_and_returns.

details.description: What happened, in the customer's words.

items.description: The products to return and how many.

id.description: Product id of an item in that order (as listed by my_orders or track_order).

order_number.description: The order number the items came from, for example 123456 (from my_orders).

reason.description: damaged, faulty, wrong_item, missing_item, change_of_mind (unused and unopened) or other.

name: start_return

duplicate.description: True when this exact request was already sent.

title: Start a return
